// @molis-ai/molis-work-contracts/platform/plugin-source-pull: public API snapshot.
// Generated by `node scripts/gates/api-snapshot.mjs --update`; do not edit by hand. A change below is a change to what plugins and other callers can use:
// say what it means for them in the PR.

export declare const PLUGIN_EVIDENCE_READ_PERMISSION = "evidence:read";

export declare const PLUGIN_SOURCE_PULL_FEED_PERMISSION = "sources:pull_feed";

export declare const PLUGIN_SOURCE_PULL_QUERY_PERMISSION = "sources:pull_query";

export interface PluginSourcePullClient {
    plan?(request: SourcePullRequest): Promise<{
        readonly intent_fingerprint: string;
    }>;
    pull?(request: SourcePullRequest, options: SourcePullOptions): Promise<SourcePullResult>;
    readonly evidence?: {
        read(content_ref: string): Promise<string | null>;
    };
    forget?(operation_ids: readonly string[]): Promise<{
        readonly records_deleted: number;
    }>;
}

export type SourcePullKind = SourcePullRequest["kind"];

export interface SourcePullMaterial {
    readonly id: string;
    readonly candidate_id: string;
    readonly canonical_url: string;
    readonly title: string;
    readonly source_name: string;
    readonly published_at?: string;
    readonly preview: string;
    readonly content_ref: string;
    readonly content_hash: string;
    readonly content_type: string;
    readonly character_count: number;
    readonly captured_at: string;
    readonly provenance: Readonly<Record<string, unknown>>;
    readonly content_available: boolean;
}

export interface SourcePullOptions {
    hold(content_refs: readonly string[]): Promise<void>;
    readonly signal?: AbortSignal;
}

export type SourcePullRequest = (SourcePullBase & {
    readonly kind: "rss";
    readonly definition_id: string;
    readonly cursor?: unknown;
}) | (SourcePullBase & {
    readonly kind: "custom_rss";
    readonly feed_url: string;
    readonly cursor?: unknown;
}) | (SourcePullBase & {
    readonly kind: "youtube_channel";
    readonly channel_id: string;
    readonly cursor?: unknown;
}) | (SourcePullBase & {
    readonly kind: "web_query";
    readonly query: string;
});

export interface SourcePullResult {
    readonly operation_id: string;
    readonly intent_fingerprint: string;
    readonly outcome: string;
    readonly requirement_met: boolean;
    readonly materials: readonly SourcePullMaterial[];
    readonly receipts: readonly unknown[];
    readonly budget: unknown;
    readonly warnings: readonly string[];
    readonly http_receipt: RssFetchReceipt | null;
}

// Declarations the exports above refer to, which no entry exports itself:

interface SourcePullBase {
    readonly operation_id: string;
    readonly source_name: string;
}
